name: Mosca2 join re-credits existing balance
summary: Mosca's join() adds the caller's existing balance above 127 USD (diff) to the new deposit before crediting it, so every join re-credits the whole balance. With a DODO flash loan the attacker joined seven times for 1,000 USDT each, compounding its internal balance, then withdrew it as USDT and USDC through withdrawFiat.
notes: A defect, not designed MLM payout: diff is already in user.balance, and join adds it again without the caller paying it.

Same deployer redeployed Mosca as this contract after the first Mosca exploit (0x4e5bb7e3 on 0x1962b335), which abused a different defect (exitProgram paying fiat balances it never zeroes), so this is a separate incident (rule 4). The earlier contract carries the same join code but no exploit of it was found.
Victim is the Mosca contract, net of the 7,000 USDT the attacker joined with in the same tx.
